thesis: The page is a surveyor's field book opened on a Roanoke hillside: every section is a plotted parcel, and the signature is the reclaimed-space ruler that measures what came back to the yard as you scroll.

signature.name: Reclaimed-Space Ruler
signature.summary: A vertical ruler line with sq-ft tick marks that grows on scroll; each section adds a job entry and the running total counts reclaimed yard space. Reused in hero, services, reviews, and footer.

palette.family: Blue Ridge Pine + Dogwood Cream + Slate

motion.intro: Letters of GONE slide in via line-mask; shed photo fades in behind. Static under reduced motion.
stories: ruler draws downward with staggered ticks on scroll
sq-ft counters count up once in view
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX, 200ms
